dominant_strengths: Restrained gold-on-black palette with elegant serif/italic pairing creates a meditative, premium tone aligned with 'cognitive clarity' positioning
Centered vignette composition and generous negative space let the headline breathe and reinforce the calm, focused mood
Problem-statement card with subtle border and icon adds editorial structure without breaking the minimalist hierarchy
dominant_weaknesses: For an onboarding flow, there is no visible progress, CTA, or next step — it reads as a marketing hero, not an actionable onboarding screen
The three numbered features (01/02/03) are cropped and lack supporting copy, leaving the value proposition abstract and unverifiable
Iconography is generic (droplet, briefcase, line chart) and doesn't visually encode the unique 'drift/intention/clarity' concepts it labels
fix_priorities: Add a clear primary CTA and onboarding progress indicator so the page performs its stated job
Expand the 01/02/03 feature triad with one-line descriptions to ground the poetic headline in concrete behavior
Replace generic icons with bespoke marks that visualize drift, lock, and score metaphors
Introduce a subtle motion or scroll cue to bridge hero into the feature grid
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral and reflective pull through typography and tone, but behavioral layer is underbuilt — there's nothing to do.
rationale.intent_fit: Beautiful as a brand hero, but weak as onboarding: it explains a philosophy without guiding the user into the product.
